instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot. In an office setting, the man in the gray blazer and jeans (R1) stands on the left in profile, shaking hands with the blonde woman in the blue t-shirt and black pants (R2) on the right. The man (R1) smiles gently at her, while the blonde woman (R2) looks back with a soft, neutral expression. They clasp right hands in a handshake. The blonde woman (R2) holds a white binder under her left arm. Bright indoor lighting fills the room, showing a whiteboard with pinned papers behind them.
